UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Per-user Firebase sync metadata and workspace UI preferences stored privately per authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in workspace sync status.

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent Google Workspace synchronization.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile document was last updated.

PickerBookmark.title: PickerBookmark
PickerBookmark.description: A Google Drive file selected via Google Picker and bookmarked in Firestore for real-time cross-device access.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the bookmark owner.

fileId.description: Google Drive file ID returned by Google Picker.

webViewLink.description: HTTPS link to open the file in Google Drive.

/userProfiles/{userId}.description: Private user sync profile and UI preferences isolated strictly to the owning UID.

/pickerBookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: User-owned Google Picker file bookmarks synchronized across sessions via Firestore.
